inputs.name: neededBuilds.scenarios
inputs.description: Scenario manifests for this verification run. Declared builds take precedence; when builds is absent, evidence supplies build ids, and missing evidence or an evidence item without a build requires all builds.

inputs.name: scopedSetup.setup
inputs.description: Configured verification setup commands in their original order; each step's builds field determines whether it is needed for the selected build ids.

inputs.name: scopedSetup.needed
inputs.description: Build ids required by this run, as returned by neededBuilds; 'all' keeps every setup step because the build requirement cannot be narrowed.

outputs.name: neededBuilds
outputs.description: Build ids required by the scenarios, collected from declared builds or evidence; 'all' signals incomplete evidence, while an explicit empty builds list yields an empty set.

outputs.name: scopedSetup
outputs.description: Setup steps to run in original order: all steps for 'all', otherwise steps without build ids and steps that name at least one needed build. The result is a new array.
